name: Ramaskandam Hanumantam
meaning: A protective remembrance naming Rama, Skanda, Hanuman, Garuda, Bhima and Shiva.
note: The wording in the client list differs from the commonly recited verse; it is held back until the version Sarvakali uses is confirmed.
supplied:
Ramaskandam Hanumantam,
Vainateyam Vrikodaram,
Shankaram Shankarasyesham,
Sarvanamami Sadanugam.
